responsibility: Declares the public entry point for the Rust privacy pass. It exposes Privacy::Resolver::resolve(HIR::Crate&) as the crate-level API used by later frontend stages to run privacy analysis over HIR, making this header the small interface layer for the privacy checker driver rather than a container for the underlying visibility, reachability, or reporting logic.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface half of the privacy-check pair: unlike rust-privacy-check.cc, it only declares the crate-level Privacy::Resolver::resolve entry point and does not contain the pass-ordering logic or visitor instantiations.
